mapper.select: select reveal_all from member_spoiler_preference where member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: insert into member_spoiler_preference (member_id, reveal_all, update_time) values (#{memberId}, #{revealAll}, now()) on duplicate key update reveal_all = values(reveal_all), update_time = now()
mapper.select: select content_id from member_spoiler_reveal where member_id = #{memberId} and content_type = #{contentType}
select id, member_id, content_type, content_id, request_id, revealed_at from member_spoiler_reveal where member_id = #{memberId} and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert ignore into member_spoiler_reveal (member_id, content_type, content_id, request_id, revealed_at) values (#{memberId}, #{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{requestId}, #{revealedAt})
